color.control.background.bottom.notes: aqua.control.solid, a=0.867, 1199 occurrences; used as the bottom stop of the control gradient, read from palette fact appkit.color.dddddd.add. The colour value is measured; the role assignment ('this is the window background') is a MavLinOS decision and stays at medium confidence until the surface captures confirm it.
